"RITUAL RING
Ritual Ring is a turn-based tactical RPG in the style of Fire Emblem. You command a small band of heroes across an 11x11 battlefield of octagon tiles, fighting one battle after another against growing bandit forces. Pick 5 of 13 heroes, read the terrain, move each unit by dragging it, then watch every clash play out in a close-up anime duel cutscene.
PLATFORM AND FORMAT
• Android, portrait, touch controls
• Built as one self-contained HTML5 file (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, canvas rendering) running in an Android WebView
• No external assets or network needed; all art and effects are drawn in code or embedded
CORE LOOP
• Title screen, then a deploy screen where you choose 5 of 13 heroes
• Player Phase: drag a unit to move, then tap an enemy to attack, tap an ally to heal, or Wait
• When all your units have acted, Enemy Phase runs automatically. There is no End Turn button
• Win by defeating every enemy. Lose if your whole team falls
• After a win, continue to the next battle with a fresh random map. After a loss, retry
MAP AND TERRAIN
• 11x11 grid of octagon tiles, randomly generated each battle
• 8-direction movement, pathfinding with terrain costs
• Plains: cost 1
• Forest: cost 2, and a unit defending in forest dodges 15% of attacks
• Mountain and Water: impassable on foot
• Flying units (Pegasus Knight, Wyvern Rider) pay 1 on every tile
COMBAT RULES
• Damage = attacker ATK minus defender DEF, minimum 1
• Defender counterattacks if alive and in range
• No critical hits
• Weapon types: sword, lance, axe, bow (range 2), magic tomes (range 2), healing staff
PLAYABLE HEROES (HP / ATK / DEF / MOVE / RANGE)
• Alden, Lord, sword: 26 / 8 / 4 / 4 / 1
• Mira, Myrmidon, sword: 22 / 8 / 2 / 5 / 1
• Bram, Knight, sword: 32 / 7 / 7 / 3 / 1
• Sera, Archer, bow: 23 / 8 / 2 / 4 / 2
• Odette, Mage, fire tome: 20 / 11 / 1 / 4 / 2
• Rowan, Cavalier, lance, horse: 27 / 8 / 4 / 6 / 1
• Celica, Pegasus Knight, lance, flying: 24 / 8 / 3 / 6 / 1
• Noel, Cleric, staff, heals 13: 21 / 0 / 2 / 4 / 1
• Dain, Fighter, axe: 30 / 10 / 3 / 4 / 1
• Vesper, Shaman, dark tome: 21 / 12 / 1 / 4 / 2
• Kestrel, Thief, sword: 22 / 7 / 3 / 5 / 1
• Rurik, Wyvern Rider, axe, flying: 30 / 9 / 5 / 5 / 1
• Elowen, Troubadour, staff, horse, heals 13: 24 / 4 / 3 / 6 / 1
ENEMIES
• Bandit, sword: 20 / 7 / 2 / 4 / 1
• Brute, axe: 32 / 9 / 4 / 3 / 1
• Hexer, enemy mage, tome: 19 / 10 / 1 / 4 / 2
• Battle 1 starts with 5 enemies, adding 1 every 2 battles up to 9
• Enemies gain +2 HP and +1 ATK as the battles climb
• Enemy AI moves toward and attacks the best target in reach
ART STYLE
• Fire Emblem Engage look: bright, anime cel-shaded character art
• Battle cutscenes on a sunny painted backdrop, with large character portraits that animate on attack and defend
• Engage-style HUD: blue player and red enemy name plates, HP bar, and a Dmg / Hit / Crit panel at the bottom
• On the map, units are small pixel chibi sprites with a number, HP bar and class icon
• Painted terrain tiles with soft daylight colors, water shimmer and layered pine forests
ANIMATION AND FEEDBACK
• Melee lunge for swords, lances and axes
• Bow draw-back with an arcing arrow
• Tome spells fire projectiles: fire, dark and holy light
• Healing sparkles, floating damage numbers, screen shake and hit flashes
• Phase banners, plus a swirl warp transition between screens
DESIGN RULES TO KEEP
• No End Turn button
• Drag-to-move controls, like Fire Emblem Heroes
• Dead units never counterattack

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build Ritual Ring as a complete, playable, self-contained HTML5 tactical RPG in `index.html`, following the supplied game, platform, control, combat, and visual requirements.

## Requirements
- Android portrait/touch-friendly, no external assets or network; all visuals rendered in code.
- Pick 5 of 13 heroes, fight on a fresh random 11×11 octagon map, and progress through increasingly difficult battles.
- Drag-to-move; attacks, healing, and Wait; enemy phase starts automatically when every living hero has acted. No End Turn button.
- Terrain costs, flying movement, range-based combat/counters, enemy AI, and dead units not counterattacking.
- Win continues; loss retries. Include duel cutscenes and feedback.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Replaced the existing Emberfall prototype with a portrait-responsive Ritual Ring interface and a canvas-rendered battlefield.
- Chose random generated terrain and enemy placement, plus a scripted close-up duel animation with cel-shaded character figures.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced `index.html` content with Ritual Ring title, deployment, battle, duel, and result-screen markup and styling.
- Added the 13 requested hero definitions and three enemy types.
- Added random terrain and battle generation, movement reachability, map rendering, roster/inspection rendering, selection, and drag movement logic.
- Added player attack/counter duel flow, healing and Wait logic foundations, enemy movement/attack flow, win/loss checks, and battle continuation/retry logic.

### Active
- Finish and validate `index.html`; the JavaScript implementation is incomplete and is not yet a playable finished game.
- Add remaining event handlers and startup/init code, including healing target selection, canvas resize/initial render, and duel interaction as needed.
- Test gameplay and mobile layout; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue editing `index.html`: finish `handleTile` healing dispatch, wire modal/touch interactions, add resize and startup initialization, and close the script/HTML document.
2. Run the game and fix runtime or gameplay issues, especially action-phase transitions, counters, and map interactions.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest capture.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation; currently mid-build.

## Important Context
- Current `index.html` ends inside the script after `enemyAct`; it still needs initialization and document closure.
- User’s final request remains to deliver the complete playable game without clarifying questions.

input.oldString: async function enemyAct(e){let players=units.filter(u=>u.team==='player'&&alive(u));if(!players.length)return;players.sort((a,b)=>(distance(e,a)+a.hp/a.maxHp*.8)-(distance(e,b)+b.hp/b.maxHp*.8));let target=players[0];if(!canReach(e,target)){let options=reachable(e,e.move),best=null,score=Infinity;for(let [k,c] of options){let [x,y]=k.split(',').map(Number);if(x===e.x&&y===e.y)continue;let d={x,y};let near=Math.min(...players.map(p=>distance(d,p)));let v=near+c*.015;if(v${e.name} closes in on your company.`);await pause(220)}}let victims=units.filter(u=>u.team==='player'&&alive(u)&&canReach(e,u)).sort((a,b)=>(a.hp/a.maxHp)-(b.hp/b.maxHp));let victim=victims[0];if(victim){addLog(`${e.name} attacks ${victim.name}.`);gameBusy=true;await new Promise(resolve=>combat(e,victim,resolve));gameBusy=true;inspectId=victim.id}}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Ritual Ring as a playable, self-contained HTML5 tactical RPG in `index.html`.
- Validate gameplay and portrait layout in Chromium, then save and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Android portrait/touch-friendly; no external assets or network; visuals rendered in code.
- Pick 5 of 13 heroes; fight on fresh random 11×11 octagon maps with increasing difficulty.
- Drag-to-move; attack, heal, or Wait; enemy phase starts when every living hero has acted. No End Turn button.
- Terrain costs, flying movement, range-based combat/counters, enemy AI, dead units cannot counterattack.
- Victory continues; loss retries. Include duel cutscenes and feedback.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Replaced the previous Emberfall prototype with a portrait-responsive Ritual Ring interface and canvas-rendered battlefield.
- Chose random terrain/enemy placement and scripted close-up duel animation with cel-shaded character figures.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented title, deployment, battle, duel, and result screens; responsive styling; all 13 heroes and three enemy types.
- Implemented random map generation, movement reachability, canvas rendering, selection/drag movement, combat/counters, healing, Wait, enemy AI, victory/loss, continuation/retry, and startup/resize handlers.
- Fixed healing selection so tapping an ally while in heal mode calls `healUnit`.
- JavaScript syntax validated with Node; Chromium produced a portrait screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/ritual-ring.png` (PNG, not yet inspected).

### Active
- Exercise gameplay in Chromium; current browser automation attempt is inconclusive and needs debugging.
- Check mobile layout and capture/inspect the requested small JPEG.

### Blocked
- Browser test script `/tmp/opencode/cdp-check.cjs` failed because `e` was undefined after selecting heroes and starting a battle; a subsequent `sed` edit accidentally split the test expression, so the script must be repaired before resuming tests.
- No confirmed runtime/gameplay test results yet.

## Next Move
1. Repair `/tmp/opencode/cdp-check.cjs` and verify deployment, movement, attack/counter, heal, Wait, enemy phase, victory, and retry in Chromium.
2. Investigate any runtime or gameplay failures found.
3. Check portrait layout; save a JPEG no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest capture.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; changes remain uncommitted.
- `/tmp/opencode/cdp-check.cjs`: Incomplete Chromium DevTools test harness requiring repair.
- `/tmp/opencode/ritual-ring.png`: Portrait Chromium screenshot, not yet inspected; PNG rather than requested JPEG.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted.
- `node` syntax check passed; Chromium screenshot command rendered the title screen.
- Attempted browser test hit `TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'x')`; follow-up test-script modification left the test expression malformed.
